notes.text: Section 945, act Mar. 4, 1927, ch. 509, § 45, 44 Stat. 1445, provided for creation of a fund to provide for payment of all expenses connected with administration of this chapter. See section 944 of this title.

Section 946, act Mar. 4, 1927, ch. 509, § 46, 44 Stat. 1445, appropriated $250,000 to be available for expenses of administration of this chapter for fiscal years ending June 30, 1927, and June 30, 1928.
Section 947, act Mar. 4, 1927, ch. 509, § 47, 44 Stat. 1445, provided for availability of appropriations for salaries and contingent expenses in administration of this chapter.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective Sept. 28, 1984, see section 28(e)(1) of Pub. L. 98–426, set out as an Effective Date of 1984 Amendment note under section 901 of this title.
